description: US producer price index for wood pulp (BLS series WPU0911, via FRED), monthly index value. This is a price index, not the RISI Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) benchmark; the route name is kept for the owner. Latest value plus up to 24 months of history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_fao_food_price_index when you need FAO Food Price Index monthly values from the FAO CSV; logistics_jet_a1_fuel_index when you need daily US Gulf Coast kerosene-type jet fuel spot price. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
